title: In Your Hands is out today: from a dream to Steam in about 10 weeks, as two people with day jobs
author: DepartmentPlus5191
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/nnty5jc1fqth1.png?width=1920&format=png&auto=webp&s=32d5e0d0a7584a2f48d012c333564ff8880c0e98

Hi, it's Hop from Nibble & Hop. Our first game, In Your Hands, is out on Steam today.

Thanks to everyone who read my earlier posts about how we used AI and how we tested 38 endings with no playtesters. Now that it's finally out, I wanted to share a few things I haven't talked about yet.

**It started with a dream**

In my first post I mentioned that Nibble came to me with an idea. What I didn't say is that the idea was a dream. Nibble had a dream one night and wanted to turn it into a game, and I suggested making it a point-and-click story game. That was the end of July. Ten weeks later, working evenings and weekends around our day jobs, here we are.

**What we wanted players to feel**

The title says a lot about what we were going for. We wanted every choice to feel like it was truly in the player's hands, and for players to feel the weight of those choices as the story unfolds. We won't say more than that, since the story is best discovered on your own.

For players who keep exploring, there's also a special ending hidden in the game. It's the part we're most proud of, and it means a lot to both of us.

**Localization was bigger than we expected**

The game ships in English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. For two people, that would have been impossible without AI. What actually made it work, though, wasn't the translation itself but the checks around it: a glossary of fixed terms, character limits measured from the real text boxes, and scripts that caught broken tags and formatting in every line.

The hardest part was the title. "In Your Hands" is a phrase that repeats in the story, so it had to work as a line of dialogue, an achievement name and a store title in every language at the same time.

**What's next**

The game is meant to be a complete experience, so we aren't planning big content updates, but we'll fix bugs as quickly as we can. If players want more languages, we're open to adding them.

We've also started planning our next game, and yes, it's based on another one of Nibble's dreams. This time we'd love to have an artist on the team. AI got us to a finished game, but keeping a consistent look across every scene took a huge amount of hand work, and we think a dedicated artist working with AI could take that much further.

**About the game**

In Your Hands is a 2 to 3 hour psychological horror sound novel, fully playable with just the mouse. It's $4.99 with a 10% launch discount.

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5193580/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5193580/)

If you play it, I'd love to know which ending you found first. And if there's a language you'd like us to add, let us know!
